_what: Where a Chromium-family browser is looked for on this computer when a tool is not told one (a bare name such as chromium, or none). In order; a name with no folder (chrome-headless-shell) is a program the row declares in invoke.programs, which the engine fetches and puts on the run's PATH; the first file found that can run wins. `~` is the person's home folder; `*` in a folder name matches any characters and the highest match is taken.
places: ~/Library/Caches/ms-playwright/chromium-*/chrome-mac*/Google Chrome for Testing.app/Contents/MacOS/Google Chrome for Testing
